audit.whatIsWrong: diff read HARD while diffRating was 4/10, tone was the favoured green, and report[14] read 'Favoured matchup' — the page contradicted itself on its own headline.
audit.why: The stored win rate is 55.26% in Quinn's favour and every other field already said favoured; only the enum token disagreed.
audit.corrected: diff HARD -> FAV. No rating changed, so this is an internal-consistency fix rather than a new claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows disagreed with the audited mirror and with the packet.
audit.why: Quinn owns 1-2 and the 4-5 window; level 3 is a knife-edge; from 6 onward Leap of Faith, then tank items and tentacle sustain, are Illaoi's. The mirror explicitly set row 3 to Quinn and rows 4 and 5 to Illaoi.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 flipped as one atomic group across both layers to Skill / Quinn / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi, ratings moved with them, and the affected why text rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two strings tell you to 'Vault out of the slam zone' or 'Vault out before the spirit can be slammed'; several call Blinding Assault a blind; the Harsh Lesson tell is absent.
audit.why: Riot's Vault text is a dash TO an enemy that lands Quinn at her maximum attack range — it is not an escape you can point at empty ground, so it cannot pull you out of a tentacle field unless she is the target. Blinding Assault hinders vision; it does not stop tentacle slams, which are not her basic attacks. Harsh Lesson is a 4-second auto-attack reset that leaps to you and makes nearby tentacles swing — the leap wind-up is the cue, not the swing.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the escape advice around Vault's real behaviour, replaced the blind with vision denial, and stated Harsh Lesson's 4s reset as the step-back tell.

audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1 and Harsh Lesson only 4s — those two numbers are the entire trade clock.
audit.corrected: Both written into the interactions line and the rewritten why text.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Illaoi must walk into your range.
edits.after: Knife-edge: your full pattern dominates open ground, but a landed Test of Spirit drags you into the tentacles.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Test of Spirit's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Blinding Assault's cooldown drops toward 9s and out-paces her tentacle sustain — shove her in, take plates, and set up R roams.

edits.before: Behind Enemy Lines exports your lead — roam on every shove. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Illaoi's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Leap of Faith slams every tentacle around her at once and your R is only a roam tool, so never sit near her wall at 6.

edits.before: Youmuu's Ghostblade is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Test of Spirit's cooldown.
edits.after: Your lethality spike pokes hard, but one clean Test of Spirit still out-trades everything it buys.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Illaoi carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Tank items plus tentacle sustain shrug off your squishy kite, and a single spirit pull in a fight deletes you.

edits.before: R is a roam/tempo tool, not duel burst, and her R slams every tentacle at once — it's a wash in a straight 1v1, so use yours to leave lane.
edits.after: Leap of Faith slams every tentacle at once while your R is tempo, not burst — don't contest her all-in at 6, take yours to the map.

edits.before: Your lethality/crit spike pokes her below threshold, but a clean E-spirit pull still trades hard — it comes down to whether she lands it.
edits.after: Your lethality/crit spike pokes her low, but a clean Test of Spirit (16s at rank 1) still out-trades it — this window is hers.

edits.before: Track Illaoi's Test of Spirit: Her vessel pull. Vault/dodge it. When it is down — Vault-blind + R her.
edits.after: Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1. Harsh Lesson is a 4s auto reset — its leap is your cue to step back.

edits.before: Bait her E (Test of Spirit) by holding a minion wave between you, then Vault out before the spirit can be slammed
edits.after: Bait Test of Spirit with a wave between you — Vault dashes onto her, so it will not pull you out of the field

edits.before: With Q blind and E-Vault online you reset Harrier procs from range while her tentacles can't reach you off the wall.
edits.after: With Blinding Assault and Vault online you stack Harrier autos on open ground where no tentacle can reach you.

edits.before: Illaoi is dangerous only inside her own tentacle field, so the whole early game is about geography — fight her on open ground, never against a wall lined with tentacles. Last-hit at the tip of your Q range and use the blind on her if she ever steps up to W-auto you. The instant she throws E (Test of Spirit) to rip your spirit, you can Vault (E) out of the slam zone or just walk wide of your tentacles — a missed E is a free trade window where you Harrier-proc her for nothing back.
edits.after: Illaoi is dangerous only inside her own tentacle field, so the whole early game is about geography — fight her on open ground, never against a wall lined with tentacles. Last-hit at the tip of Blinding Assault's 1025 range, and treat the Harsh Lesson leap as your step-back cue: it resets her auto every 4 seconds. Vault dashes onto her, not away, so walk clear of the spirit instead — a missed Test of Spirit is 16 seconds of free Harrier trades.

edits.before: This is your lane. By levels 4-5 your Q cooldown drops and you out-poke her sustain on open ground — shove her in, take plates, and start threatening R roams to side lanes while she's stuck farming. At 6 respect her R: it slams every tentacle around her simultaneously, so don't be caught hugging the wall low. Trade in short bursts — E in for the Harrier reset, blind her auto, and disengage with W's move speed before her tentacles wind up.
edits.after: This is your lane. By levels 4-5 Blinding Assault's cooldown drops and you out-poke her sustain on open ground — shove her in, take plates, and threaten R roams while she is stuck farming. At 6 respect Leap of Faith: it slams every tentacle around her at once, so never hug the wall low. Trade in short bursts — Vault in for the Harrier auto and leave on Heightened Senses move speed before the tentacles wind up.

notes: Illaoi's R carries a 'grounding' flag in the kit file, but Riot's Leap of Faith text says only damage plus a tentacle per champion hit — per the brief's rule I trusted the description and asserted no grounding anywhere. Two data conflicts worth knowing: the packet header lists games 286 at the top and 152 inside the packet block, and the packet chart gives Skill/Skill on the Level 6 and First item rows while the audited mirror set both to Illaoi. I followed the mirror on those two rows — see questionsForUser.
